definition.can_answer_true: The requested target can reasonably be answered from the available pathology WSI, either directly from H&E morphology or as a categorical tissue-linked phenotype that can be predicted from WSI.
definition.can_answer_false: The requested fact requires report/gross-specimen/clinical/procedural/follow-up context, exact case-level measurements, exact staging, or actual assay-specific measurements/results that are not recoverable from the WSI alone.
definition.excluded: Malformed or internally inconsistent benchmark item. Use can_answer=null and exclude_from_evaluation=true.

evaluation_protocol.answerability: Evaluate can_answer true vs false on all non-excluded MC questions.
evaluation_protocol.primary_vqa: Evaluate VQA accuracy on the fixed GOLD can_answer=true subset. If a model abstains on a GOLD can_answer=true question, count it as wrong.
evaluation_protocol.fairness: Use exactly the same GOLD can_answer=true subset for Ours and every baseline.

false_if_question_requires: exact tumor/specimen/lesion size, diameter, dimension, measurement, percentage, distance, or focus count
AJCC/TNM/pathologic stage or exact case-level extent
surgical margin status/distance/orientation or specimen-location facts
patient age, symptoms, history, medication, treatment, consent, performance status, or other clinical metadata
procedure performed, stains/tests performed or pending, recommendations, report wording, specimen format/site
exact receptor percentage or continuous assay score
actual FISH/amplification or other assay-specific measurement/result
vital status or exact survival time
true_if_question_targets: histologic or nuclear grade and histology-derived Nottingham grading/score
benign breast morphology such as hyperplasia, adenosis, metaplasia, fibroadenoma, or fibrocystic change
